title: MaleTheme Solo #020 · 남 맨즈 피지크·코퍼 브론즈·경찰관 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunny seaside promenade of pale paving stones with a waist-high white railing, a lamp post and a row of normal-height beach huts, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as him, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, sharp focus from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult Mexican man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty-boy idol face with flawless smooth skin, large clear eyes, a slim jaw and soft full lips, clean-shaven, copper-bronze smoky eyes with a golden highlight, smooth warm light-brown skin, a relaxed easygoing look with a faint smile, bold vivid emerald-green hair styled in curly, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large copper hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a tin pyramid-shaped lump, a gold teardrop-shaped sinker, a silver ship's anchor, a lead round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large copper hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a copper small flared temple bell, a gold barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered gold anklets. Extremely long stiletto nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
SUBJECT Physique: An extraordinarily tall and large man, far beyond any real person, with a men's physique build. Enormously broad shoulders with round capped deltoids, a wide upper chest tapering sharply to a very narrow waist in a dramatic V-taper, a lean sharply defined six-pack abdomen with visible obliques, thick strong arms, and long lean athletic legs that are muscular but not bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
SUBJECT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a black police cap with a silver badge, a thin black leather chest harness carrying a silver badge, steel handcuffs hanging from one hip string, and a minimal black leather T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.
SUBJECT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme gold platform high heels, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
